title: Parasite
creator: Bong Joon-ho
summary: A poor Korean family insinuates itself into a wealthy household. Then the film changes completely.
personalNote: The most purely constructed film I've seen in years. Bong choreographs class anxiety like a thriller — every scene plants a seed that detonates later. The genre shift halfway through is genuinely shocking even when you're expecting it. I've seen it three times and I still notice new things.
